title: Angle Pairs
description: An interactive MicroSim exploring different types of angle pairs including complementary, supplementary, vertical, and adjacent angles.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Angles
learningObjectives: Identify complementary, supplementary, vertical, and adjacent angle pairs from their defining properties
Explain why complementary angles sum to 90 degrees and supplementary angles sum to 180 degrees
Calculate the measure of a missing angle when its complement or supplement is known
Distinguish vertical angles, which are opposite and equal, from adjacent angles that share a common side and vertex
